# TutorialsPoint

> TutorialsPoint is a comprehensive learning platform offering 3500+ coding problems, tutorials, and practice tools across programming languages, data science, DevOps, and enterprise technologies.

TutorialsPoint provides beginner-to-advanced tutorials, interactive coding environments, and developer tools covering the full spectrum of modern software development. The platform serves as both a learning resource and a practical development utility hub.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Java
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Web Development
- DevOps
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Database Systems
- Big Data
- Mobile Development
- Cloud Computing
- Coding Practice
- Data Structures & Algorithms
- Software Testing

## Core Learning & Practice

- [TutorialsPoint Homepage](https://www.tutorialspoint.com): Main platform hub with 3500+ coding problems, DSA tutorials, and comprehensive practice platform
- [Online Coding Environment](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/codingground.htm): Free online compilers and editors for C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, PHP and other languages
- [Technical Articles & Resources](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/articles/index.php): Index of technical articles covering Python, Java, JavaScript, PHP with practical examples

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [Python Technologies Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/python_technologies_tutorials.htm): Python ecosystem tutorials including AI, Beautiful Soup, Behave, data science, and machine learning
- [Java Technologies Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/java_technology_tutorials.htm): Comprehensive Java tutorials covering Apache Ant, ActiveMQ, POI, AWT, and 99+ frameworks
- [Web Development Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/web_development_tutorials.htm): Full-stack web development tutorials including Angular, Ajax, AWS, and modern frontend/backend technologies
- [Microsoft Technologies Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/microsoft_technologies_tutorials.htm): Microsoft ecosystem tutorials covering ASP.Net Core, ASP.Net MVC, Excel, and cloud computing
- [Mobile Development Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/mobile_development_tutorials.htm): Mobile app development tutorials for Android, Flutter, Cordova, and cross-platform frameworks

## Data, AI & Analytics

- [Machine Learning Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/machine_learning_tutorials.htm): ML and AI tutorials covering deep learning, Apache MXNet, ChatGPT, Claude AI, and generative AI
- [Big Data & Analytics Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/big_data_tutorials.htm): Big data processing tutorials including Hadoop, Kafka, Flume, Pig, Solr, and analytics tools
- [Database Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/database_tutorials.htm): Database tutorials covering SQL, NoSQL, Amazon RDS, ArangoDB, Apache Presto, and Derby
- [Computer Science Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/computer_science_tutorials.htm): Foundational computer science catalog including Python, Django, Flask, data science, DevOps, and ML

## DevOps & Infrastructure

- [DevOps Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/devops_tutorials.htm): DevOps tutorials covering Ansible, Chef, Consul, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and containers

## Developer Tools & Utilities

- [Software Development & Testing Tools](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/online_dev_tools.htm): Developer utilities including code formatters, minifiers, JSON tools, network and security tools

## Optional

- [Software Quality Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/software_quality_tutorials.htm): QA and testing tutorials covering Agile testing, Bugzilla, mockups, and testing frameworks
- [Digital Marketing Tutorials](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/digital_marketing_tutorials.htm): Digital marketing tutorials including SEO, social media, Google Tag Manager, and Amazon Marketplace
